title: Section · H2 narrative
description: Single-purpose narrative section: eyebrow + H2 + 3 paragraphs. Used as the framing pattern for soft sections (AI / SMB / Scalable / Operational philosophy) where the message is the visual. The canonical variant is text-first; an optional side SVG glyph remains available through data-has-glyph='true'.

source.adapted_from: v5 dark → light tokens. Glyph slot generalized to allow any inline SVG.
source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-25 — canonical narrative block is text-first; glyph is optional variant, not default

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

notes: Canonical harness uses data-has-glyph='false' and presents a text-first narrative block with a secondary-accent rule.
Set data-has-glyph='true' on the section to restore the optional glyph column. Replace the inline SVG inside [data-glyph-slot] only for page-specific variants.
At ≤900px the glyph moves above the text (order: -1) and shrinks to 220px max.
